series_title: The Legion of Super-Heroes in the 31st Century
description: An all-new series spinning out of the smash-hit TV show, written by J. Torres (TEEN TITANS GO, Sidekicks, Alison Dare: Little Miss Adventures) and drawn by the creator of the indie favorite Blue Monday, Chynna Clugston-Flores! To stop the Fatal Five from destroying Metropolis, the Legion of Super-Heroes travel back in time for reinforcements, because this looks like a job for...Clark Kent?! Can six teenagers from the future help a mild-mannered reporter become the Man of Steel, or will the Fatal Five determine his destiny before it's even begun?

series_title: The Legion of Super-Heroes in the 31st Century
description: An ancient legacy catches up with Brainiac 5 when he learns the terrible secret of his great-great-grandfather, Brainiac 1...one of Superman's greatest enemies! To make it up to Superman, Brainy takes him on a trip to his home planet's past - but an unexpected detour to the Phantom Zone could mean disaster!

series_title: The Legion of Super-Heroes in the 31st Century
description: With the Man of Steel a thousand years away, Brainiac 5 takes the time to complete his records of Superman's time with the Legion, including a never-before-seen adventure on Mars. One of Superman's future allies has a legacy at stake - can the Legion help Superman set it right?

series_title: The Legion of Super-Heroes in the 31st Century
description: Back home in Metropolis, villains aren't nearly as fearsome as the Fatal Five, but they're learning fast! Although they're 1000 years away, the Legion has never left Superman's mind for a minute - will Superman's 31st Century know-how be enough to stop 21st Century bad guys, or will the learning curve be steeper than he can handle?

series_title: The Legion of Super-Heroes in the 31st Century
description: “BACK IN METROPOLIS!” As Superman begins his public career, including putting a stop to Lex Luthor’s Lex-O-Skeleton 3000 run amok, he remembers the lessons of his training with the Legion of Super-Heroes. Meanwhile, Brainiac keeps track of the new hero from afar.

series_title: The Legion of Super-Heroes in the 31st Century
description: A distress call from a stranded United Planets' ship pits the Legion against a gang of rogue Thanagarian pirates - and they're not exactly carrying on Hawkman's heroic legacy!

series_title: The Legion of Super-Heroes in the 31st Century
description: “IN A FLASH.” Bouncing Boy and Triplicate Girl finally get their second date, but the trend of nothing ever going as Chuck plans continues when they get hopelessly lost in virtual reality...with a fast-talking, impulsive brat named Bart as their guide! Can they put their differences aside to stop a virtual threat that gets very real, threatening the existence of New Metropolis?

series_title: The Legion of Super-Heroes in the 31st Century
issue_title: The Untold Legend of Arm-Fall-Off Boy
description:
“THE UNTOLD LEGEND OF ARM-FALL-OFF BOY!” The embarrassingly powered would-be Legionnaire wants nothing more than a flight ring and for Saturn Girl to know his name. But since flight technology and easily detached limbs don’t always mix, Arm-Fall-Off Boy has his work cut out for him!

It's the issue you've been waiting for: The untold story of Arm-Fall-Off Boy! The embarrassingly powered would-be Legionnaire wants nothing more than a flight ring and for Phantom Girl to know his name. But since flight technology and easily detached limbs don't always mix, Arm-Fall-Off Boy has his work cut out for him! Also in this issue: the menace of Starfinger!

series_title: The Legion of Super-Heroes in the 31st Century
description: A distress call from a stranded United Planets ship pits the Legion against a gang of Thanagarian pirates - and they're not exactly carrying on Hawkman's heroic legacy! The team will have to call in the big guns, but their best hope is 1,000 years away.

series_title: The Legion of Super-Heroes in the 31st Century
description: “FAILURE TO COMMUNICATE.” Computer chaos hits New Metropolis, crippling the high-tech city and throwing the Legion into the Dark Ages as communications crash, starships collide and magic takes over! Brainiac 5 has to prove that science is stronger than sorcery...but will he have to give up his place in the Legion to do it?

series_title: The Legion of Super-Heroes in the 31st Century
description: “BOOSTER.” Heroes sometimes face the dilemma of choosing when to break rules in order to serve the greater good. That predicament is truly encountered when the Legion meets Booster Gold. But is he crossing the line or simply fulfilling his destiny?

series_title: The Legion of Super-Heroes in the 31st Century
description:
On the planet Raal, Timber Wolf was nothing but a beast. But in the Legion, he could be a super hero! Can he keep it together long enough to make it back home, or will this be the shortest membership on record?

The Legion has a new recruit in Timber Wolf but can this feral, traumatized super-being be successfully integrated into the team?

series_title: The Legion of Super-Heroes in the 31st Century
description: Metallo journeys to the future for the ultimate power source: Kryptonite! But if he destroys Superman, will the Legion's fate unravel, as well? Don't miss the exciting conclusion to this amazing series!

series_title: The Legion of Super-Heroes in the 31st Century
description: Auditions can be scary, especially when the team you're trying out for is the Legion of Super-Heroes! But a small-planet girl is about to make good when a big-time threat proves more than the Legion can handle. So say what you want about substitutes, we think they look pretty good together!

series_title: The Legion of Super-Heroes in the 31st Century
description: It's just another day in the life of a half-living computer, half-teenaged super-hero: fighting crime, saving the galaxy, acing your final exams. Will brains win out over brawn when the Fatal Five come to Brainy's home planet? Or will failure be the first thing on Brainy's permanent record?

series_title: The Legion of Super-Heroes in the 31st Century
description: Whoever said 'lightning never strikes twice' never met Lightning Lad! What starts as a friendly challenge turns into the storm of the century under Emerald Empress's watchful Eye, pitting Superman against Lightning Lad for the fate of the Legion!

series_title: The Legion of Super-Heroes in the 31st Century
issue_title: Attack of the Green Lantern Corps
description: “ATTACK OF THE GREEN LANTERN CORPS!” In brightest day, in blackest night, beware their power...Teen Lantern’s light! It’s an all-out battle as the Legion faces the combined might of the universe’s bravest! Can the Legion convince the Green Lantern Corps to join forces against an even greater threat, or will the original teen superheroes be replaced?

series_title: The Legion of Super-Heroes in the 31st Century
description:
“NO BOYS ALLOWED!” The Legion is called to the planet of New Themyscira, where the only rule is No Boys Allowed. But when the princess is kidnapped and the boys decide to sneak in, will it be love at first fight?

Circe has been placed on the throne of New Themyscira as its Regent while Xenobia, the true Princess is too young to rule. Circe kidnaps Xenobia who is missed by her girl friends in the Legion of Superheroes that were planning a trip together.

Triplicate Girl, Phantom Girl and Saturn Girl head to New Themyscira to find their friend. Circe traps them in them same containment cell as Xeno. The boys of the Legion can't resist a planet full of women and head there only to find that they are not welcomed with open arms. After a quick battle, the boys find the girls and free them.

Circe has her animorphing fun by turning all the boys into pigs, one of her favorite tricks. Circe is protected by a spell that prohibits other women from causing her any harm and with the boys turned into pigs, it looks like the Legion girls have to come up with a clever plan to defeat their foe. The girls use the superpigs more like handheld weapons and fire upon Circe, ultimately defeating her.

series_title: The Legion of Super-Heroes in the 31st Century
description: Two's company, three's a crowd...unless you're Triplicate Girl! Find out what happens when you combine a first date, a stubborn Super-Villain suitor and one very long night of monitor duty.

series_title: The Legion of Super-Heroes in the 31st Century

To make it up to Superman, Brainy takes him on a trip to his home planet's past - but an unexpected detour to the Phantom Zone could mean disaster!

series_title: Injustice: Gods Among Us Year Five
description:
This is it: the final year of INJUSTICE:GODS AMONG US, leading into the storyline of the hit videogame! Having defeated the Green Lantern Corps, the forces of magic, and now the gods themselves, the Regime seems to have eliminated all threats. Yet uneasy lies the crown on the head of Emperor Superman. Still obsessed with the outlaw Batman and worried about having enough troops to police his world, The Man of Steel begins to recruit some of Earth’s deadliest villains to his side. Does the Dark Knight have any chance of ending the Man of Steel’s rule?

series_title: Injustice: Gods Among Us Year Five
description: Lex Luthor is determined to destroy Bizarro before Superman figures out that Lex created the murderous super-monster in the first place! But he needs an equally powerful being to carry out the deed—and turns to none other than Doomsday!

series_title: Injustice: Gods Among Us Year Five
description: It’s on! Harley has a lot to get out of her system, and the first person who’s going to get a dose of it is the guy she had a brief crush on—Shazam. But “Shazzy’s” not buying what’s Harley’s selling, so things are about to get…complicated. Meanwhile, Superman pays a visit to a man who once head-butted him.

series_title: Injustice: Gods Among Us Year Five
description: Batman has opposed Superman’s Regime since the beginning, while Damian (now Nightwing) threw his support behind the Man of Steel. Father and son, on opposite sides. So what act perpetrated by Victor Zsasz could be so heinous as to make these two join forces again to track him down? Don’t miss the shocking answer.

series_title: Injustice: Gods Among Us Year Five
description: It’s Damian at the crossroads when he must make a final, fateful choice between his biological father—Batman—and his current father figure, Superman. The new Nightwing can end the conflict that’s torn the world asunder these past five years, but either the Dark Knight or the Man of Steel is going to have to die.

series_title: Injustice: Gods Among Us Year Five
description: Since the rise of the Regime, The Flash has always been one of Superman’s most tenuous allies. Now his loyalty is really going to be tested, as someone he loves has to face Superman’s unswerving justice. Then, with the Speedster at his most vulnerable, Batman offers him a risky way out.

series_title: Injustice: Gods Among Us Year Five
description: Batman forms an alliance with the savage Hawkman, who is still determined to remove Hawkgirl from Superman’s regime. How does the warrior from Thanagar hope to succeed in defeating The Man of Steel where so many have failed? By getting his hands on some Kryptonite, and he claims to know where to find it.

series_title: Injustice: Gods Among Us Year Five
description: Batman forms an alliance with the savage Hawkman, who is still determined to remove Batman and Batgirl hatch a plot to break into Cyborg’s database and get their hands on footage of Superman’s many executions. Their goal is to broadcast it to the world, and turn everyone against the regime. Meanwhile, an enraged and kryptonite-armed Hawkman finally has his confrontation with the Man of Steel!

series_title: Injustice: Gods Among Us Year Five
description: Superman is laid low by the effects of the Kryptonite poisoning administered by Hawkman. Batman and the Resistance continue to hold Cyborg as they try to transmit the video that will show the public how Superman slaughtered a group of unarmed demonstrators. Meanwhile, Luthor may have finally found a means to take down the Man of Steel.

series_title: Injustice: Gods Among Us Year Five
description: Enter: Deathstroke! Batman and Luthor are close to finishing a device that will open a door to another reality and bring them some much-needed assistance that could finally end this war. But they need a component that only Slade Wilson can retrieve. Can he be trusted? Meanwhile, Raven re-enters the fray, and a couple of dark gods conspire to cause trouble on Earth.

series_title: Injustice: Gods Among Us Year Five
description: Imagine a world where Superman never turned evil. Imagine a reality where Superman and Batman are still allies in a never-ending battle against crime and cosmic-level threats against Earth. As the series approaches its conclusion, a better world is revealed, and a glimmer of hope is given to another reality still held in the grip of Superman’s Regime.

series_title: Injustice: Gods Among Us Year Five
description: Superman and Flash find themselves up against the deadly Doomsday. They could use more help from their allies, but Cyborg and Yellow Lantern are off battling the Parasite. The Regime is under siege from both sides. Meanwhile, the identity of the creature that escaped from Lex Luthor’s lab is revealed.

series_title: Injustice: Gods Among Us Year Five
description:
Year Five and the entire INJUSTICE saga reaches its dramatic conclusion, leaving readers right where the story of the first Injustice game begins! Batman and Luthor race to finish constructing the device they think will save the world, just as Superman closes in on Batman’s secret base. Old foes return and new allies are revealed. But who will be the next to make the ultimate sacrifice?

FINAL ISSUE

series_title: Injustice: Gods Among Us Year Five
description: Killer Frost has Catwoman on ice, trying to coerce her into coming over to the side of the Regime. When Batman comes to her rescue, Frost brings some muscle to the fight: Superman’s newest henchman, Bane! Meanwhile, Damian has a pivotal encounter with Alfred.

series_title: Injustice: Gods Among Us Year Five
description: While Hawkgirl has been on Earth serving as one of Superman’s most loyal foot soldiers, where has Hawkman been all this time? Back home on Thanagar, it seems, and none to pleased about the reason for his wife’s absence. Now he’s heading for Earth and a fateful confrontation. Elsewhere, Flash’s Rogues have joined the Insurgency to stage a series of lightning attacks on multiple cities.

series_title: Injustice: Gods Among Us Year Five
issue_title: The Curious Case of Bizaarro Superman
description: A major rift develops between Batman and Catwoman as she questions how his use of villains in the Insurgency makes him any better than Superman. Meanwhile, Bizarro takes on a bunch of bad guys, and Raven finally makes her return. But is she back to help Superman, or does she have another agenda?

series_title: Injustice: Gods Among Us Year Five
description: The moment everyone has been waiting for: Damian finally dons the costume of Nightwing. But what motivates him to do so—and what does he think it will accomplish? The answer may reveal itself when he encounters Catwoman, who seems to have returned to her criminal ways. Plus, Superman takes on Solomon Grundy!

series_title: Injustice: Gods Among Us Year Five
description: Catwoman's departure from the insurgency seems complete as she returns to her life of crime. Harley decides to join her for a bit of fun. But things turn grim as they run into Damian, who is undergoing a transformation himself...into the new Nightwing!

series_title: Injustice: Gods Among Us Year Five
description: Harley confronts a gathering of rebellion-minded Joker devotees in one of the late criminal’s old hideouts and doesn’t know quite what to make of them. Batwoman tries to break things up. And just when it looks like things are under control, tragedy strikes.

series_title: Injustice: Gods Among Us Year Five
description: The tragicomic journey of Bizarro takes a dark turn. Guided by the Trickster, every attempt to do something good leads to something far, far worse. Can Superman and the Regime stop him before the scale of his destructive blunders leads to a major disaster?

"NOT BRAND X" Part 1

X-FACTOR IS BACK...LIKE NEVER BEFORE! Serval Industries, one of the world's most trusted names in electronics and leader in cutting-edge internet and weapons technology, has just unveiled their newest contribution to society...the All-New X-Factor. Led by mutant mistress of magnetism, Polaris, the team uses its corporate backing for the betterment of society. With her half-brother Quicksilver, notorious thief, Gambit, and more by her side, can Polaris trust that her corporate masters really have good intentions?

It's not like any of the members have secrets, right?

Quicksilver is reunited with his daughter, Luna...

PLUS: could Warlock make a move on Danger?

issue_title: Just Another Day at the Office
description:
AXIS tie-in!

Washington is burning!

Will Serval Enterprises’ X-Factor put out the fire?

Or will they watch it burn?

issue_title: Fall Back! Get Back Behind the Shield!
description:
AXIS TIE-IN!

X-Factor has stolen the Nuclear Football from a Red Skull-controlled President and taken it back to Serval Headquarters for protection…but what happens when they’re greeted by a welcoming committee of Sentinels?!

Gambit takes his shirt off!

AXIS TIE-IN!

The X-Factor team, having stolen the nuclear football from the President, now has to handle a direct attack on Serval Industries courtesy of Longshot and Sunfire. Meanwhile, Quicksilver is kidnapped under extremely mysterious circumstances.
Sunfire returns to X-Factor with an odd proposal. Meanwhile the team is dispatched to the Middle East to intervene in an ongoing war between two countries.

It was supposed to be a straightforward mission for the team: go into a foreign country at war with its neighbor, discover the tunnels that the enemy had created and get rid of them.

Unfortunately things have gone extremely wrong and now a vengeful Egyptian goddess has been set free, and the first people she's targeting are X-Factor.

issue_title: Not Brand X, Part 2: Now Hold on Tightly
description:

Mayhem In Munchkinland - Part 1

After purchasing a chest of old comics from an unwitting old gent, Kevin and Peter return to the home of their friend Mary to check out their good fortune. Inside they find a tome which, when opened, releases a powerful magic gateway in the form of a tornado. The three friends appear in the middle of a battle of short warriors. Kevin and Peter are pushed into a field of flowers where the minuscule fighters dare not follow. Mary, manages to outrun her pursuers for a while, but is finally caught. Astonishingly, she is saved by a tall "man" made of sticks and with a pumpkin for a head!

Kevin Ross and Peter Stevens buy a footlocker of old books and comics. They look to make a fortune but when they open a lock on a very old looking book a tornado that at first seemed like a photo literally comes to life and whisks them away along with Mary Warren and their dog max to the land of Oz.

Disoriented form the tornado and confused by their situation things get worse when they are attacked by a bunch of Munchkins. The munchkins are violent and the group are split in two trying to get away with Kevin and Ross going one way and Mary going the other. Now separated The group can also add lost to their mysterious predicament.

Reunion

After their recent series of setbacks, out heroes gain some ground against their foes. The Freedom Fighters, somewhat reluctantly, accept that the three Evil Kings have now returned to their normal good selves. Kevin and Mary are finally re-united since they were separated in the first issue. Jack Pumpkinhead is discovered alive. And the true ruler of Oz, Queen Ozma is freed from the Nome King's dungeon.

Queen Ozma begins a tour of Oz to enlist the aid of her still-faithful subjects in raising an army to fight the Nome King. Peter remains a prisoner of that tyrant, and is sent to Mombi's torture chamber when it is discovered that Ozma has escaped. Eluding his guards, Peter becomes lost in the Emerald Castle and meets up with a young woman ensorcelled just as the Evil Kings had been. Freeing her, Peter discovers one of the most famous residents of Oz: Dorothy Gale of Kansas! Based on the Wonderful Wizard of Oz books.

Queen Ozma discovers that Oz has truly been changed forever when her former subjects, the Quadlings, refuse her request to join an army against the Nome King. They no longer see her as fit to lead them. Peter and Dorothy encounter a band of sword-wielding goblins in the tunnels below the Emerald Castle. And the Freedom Fighters make a daring aerial assault of the Emerald Castle and come face to face with a desperate and deadly Witch Mombi! Based on the Wonderful Wizard of Oz books.

Mombi banishes the attacking Freedom Fighters to Earth where they encounter death in the form of traffic, overhead power lines, gun-happy policemen, street gangs, helicopters and tanks! Their only hope of salvation comes in the form of the Earth dog, Max. And a volcano mysteriously appears and erupts in the middle of a once-quiet meadow to the south! Based on the Wonderful Wizard of Oz books.

The Winged Monkeys finally see the need in helping the Freedom Fighters, but then become pawns of the Nome King when he reveals he has the missing Monkey Cap which magically controls their allegiance. In a great finale battle, all of the players from the previous issues meet to decide the fate of Oz, once and for all! Based on the Wonderful Wizard of Oz books.
A new evil is afoot in the southern lands of Oz as Goblins and Quadlings form an unholy alliance, all through the manipulations of the mysterious Shaman. Based on the Wonderful Wizard of Oz books.

While there is celebration in Oz as news of the Nome King's defeat spreads through the land, Queen Ozma is faced with the daunting task of rebuilding her war-torn country. The Wizard, returned from his banishment to Earth, grants Kevin, Peter and Mary's request to go back to Earth. Meanwhile, the Shaman introduces the source of his mysterious power...the Wickedest Witch of Oz! Based on the Wonderful Wizard of Oz books.

Amber Ombi struggles to build the All-Ozzian Army in a land which has never before felt the need for a large military presence. The Wizard grows concerned about the sudden appearance of the southern volcano. Dorothy, who lost ten years of her life to the Nome King's spell, decides to search Oz for the fabled Fountain of Youth in an attempt to return to her twelve-year-old self. And an army of magically-enhanced Goblins rages through Winkieland, as the threat of the Wickedest Witch grows. Based on the classic Wonderful Wizard of Oz books.

This issue also features The Black Bombers story "The Black Star Strikes" by Ron Fortier, Christopher A. Jones and Gary Kato.

The newly-independent Quadlings set out to destroy the Lion and the forest he ruled as an Evil King, to avenge the crimes Lion inflicted upon them during those dark days. Meanwhile, Dorothy and her childhood friends Trot and Betsy Bobbin, along with Scarecrow, Tin Man and Hungry Tiger, set out for Good Witch Glinda's castle to the north in search of clues to the whereabouts of the Fountain of Youth. Based on the Wonderful Wizard of Oz books.

The Wickedest Witch's powers continue to grow, along with the strength of the Goblin horde army, leading to a showdown with the Witch and the Goblin King. Lion, Jinjur and Jack Pumpkinhead discover the devastation wrought by the Quadlings upon the Lion's animal forest domain. And the Wizard and Amber Ombi butt heads over the role of the new All-Ozzian Army in this post-Nome King Oz. Based on the Wonderful Wizard of Oz books.

Mayhem In Munchkinland - Part 2

While Mary travels to an unknown destination with her savior, Jack Pumpkinhead, Kevin and Peter battle a creature part bear and part tiger, barely escaping with their lives. Wounded, they stumble into what appears to be an abandoned village and meet up with an ancient version of the tiny warriors they faced earlier. When the old man refers to Oz, Munchkinland, Dorothy and the Wizard, it is almost more than the Earther's minds can take. They decide that, in order to find the missing Mary, they must meet with the ruler of Munchkinland, the Scarecrow!

The Wickedest Witch consolidates her power as the new Queen of the Goblins. General Jinjur and Jack Pumpkinhead, on a mission to discover the source of the mysterious southern volcano, meet the Witch, with disastrous consequences. Meanwhile, Queen Ozma decides to embark on a diplomatic mission to Quadling Country to stop what may become a deadly Civil War in the land of Oz. Based on the Wonderful Wizard of Oz books.

Mayhem In Munchkinland - Part 3

Kevin and Peter and Max the dog must battle the Scarecrow! He is not a jolly, floppy sack of straw, however. He is now one of three Evil Kings who rule Oz. Meanwhile, Mary and Jack Pumpkinhead reach their destination: the secret headquarters of the Freedom Fighters of Oz. Made up of members of many of the strange and dissimilar races that populate Oz, the ragtag band has vowed to rid their homeland of the tyrannical Nome King and his Evil Kings, or die trying!

Allies and Enemies

The mayhem in Munchkinland continues! Mary is caught up in a battle between her new friends the Freedom Fighters and the evil Ladies Auxiliary Brigade led by the Nome King's henchwoman, Witch Mombi. At the same time, Kevin, Peter, Max and the newly dis-enchanted Scarecrow meet up with the second Evil King, the Tin Woodsman. And does he have an axe to grind!

Heroes Gather, Battles Fought.

Kevin and Peter, with their new allies Scarecrow and Tin Man, decide to seek out the third Evil King in hopes of breaking the spell that he, too, must be under. The Lion, however, is certainly no coward, and his teeth and claws are ready for battle! Meanwhile, Mary and the Freedom Fighters escape the trap set by Witch Mombi's Ladies Auxiliary Brigade, but at what cost?

Gathering of Armies.

The heroes gather! Scarecrow, Tin Man, and Lion are no longer pawns under the spell of the wicked Nome King. They, along with the Earthers, Kevin and Peter, decide it is time to take the fight to the Nome King. Along the way to the Emerald City, Kevin and Peter get a crash course in Oz history. Meanwhile, one of the Freedom Fighters, a Winged Monkey with no name, attempts to bring his race into the Nome King conflict. But will the reclusive Monkey folk answer the call?

Monkey in the Middle

Kevin, Peter, and the three former Evil Kings arrive at the gates of the Emerald City with plans to oust the usurper of Queen Ozma's throne, only to find an army of Nome warriors waiting for them. The unnamed Wing Monkey reveals his secret, shameful past and must pay for his crimes against his tribe. Meanwhile, Mary and the Freedom Fighters are beset by hideous and powerful Bane Wolves in this all-action issue!

The Itsy Bitsy Spider....

In a disastrous battle with the Nome King's diminutive army, Scarecrow, Tin Man, Lion and Kevin must flee the Emerald City. But without Peter, who has been captured by the Nomes and brought to face the Nome King himself. Mary and the Freedom Fighters are seeking a covert passage into the Emerald City via abandoned Nome tunnels, and face a horrible, subterranean foe. And what of the mysterious, missing Monkey Cap?

Clash of the Titans

The Freedom Fighters and Mary finally emerge from the underground tunnels, mourning the loss of Jack Pumpkinhead. Kevin is furious with Scarecrow, Tin Man and Lion for allowing his friend Peter to be captured by the Nome King. And in a terrible case of mistaken identities, the Freedom Fighters finally meet up with the former Evil Kings, but don't realize they have been freed of the spells that were upon them. It's a battle between heroes!
